title: Preview telemetry credential request
description: Same-origin POST /__utrace/telemetry-credential body: the verified document attestation, exchanged once, together with the nonce of the document that holds it. The browser SDK owns this request, so it carries no preview envelope discriminator.

attestation.description: Detached Ed25519 signature over a base64url JSON payload, relayed to the browser exactly as the control plane issued it. Owned by browser-observation/common/v1#/$defs/signed_envelope.
